description: §40.2 (S443 review F2) — the `<program>` and its `<page>` both declare `auth="required"`: the declarations agree, so W-AUTH-FILE-CONFLICT does not fire.
rationale: §40.2 (S443): W-AUTH-FILE-CONFLICT is for a file mixing `auth="required"` with a laxer `auth=`; agreeing declarations are not a conflict.
